evidence.detail: No project-owned file imports pkg_resources; all occurrences are inside .venv (werkzeug, sentry_sdk, pytest monkeypatch, babel, pytz)
filterwarnings section already suppresses two similar DeprecationWarnings from flask_restx and flask_babel with per-package ignore lines; the same pattern can suppress this one

triage.fix_sketch: Add one line to the filterwarnings section of pytest.ini: `ignore:.*pkg_resources is deprecated.*:DeprecationWarning`. The warning originates entirely in third-party .venv packages (pytest monkeypatch, babel, werkzeug) — no project code uses pkg_resources — so suppression is the correct response, exactly matching the existing pattern for flask_restx and flask_babel.
triage.notes: Suppression only; does not fix the third-party packages. If a future dep update removes their pkg_resources usage the filterwarnings line becomes harmless dead config.
